# jumpcloud Provider

Manage JumpCloud user groups, group memberships, OIDC applications, and application access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    jumpcloud = {
      source = "loadsmart/jumpcloud"
    }
  }
}

# Reads JUMPCLOUD_API_KEY (and JUMPCLOUD_ORG_ID, JUMPCLOUD_API_URL) from the environment.
provider "jumpcloud" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) JumpCloud API key. Can also be set with the `JUMPCLOUD_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `api_url` (String) JumpCloud console base URL. Defaults to `https://console.jumpcloud.com`; use `https://console.eu.jumpcloud.com` for EU organizations. Can also be set with the `JUMPCLOUD_API_URL` environment variable.
- `org_id` (String) JumpCloud organization ID, required only for multi-tenant (MTP) administrators. Can also be set with the `JUMPCLOUD_ORG_ID` environment variable.
